You haven't logged anything yet, so I can't see what you did on day 1 or what program you're running. That said: soreness after your first lift in years is normal. It'll peak in a couple of days and then drop off — that's just your body adapting, not a sign something went wrong.

For day 2, you have two options. If you're running a program, start it on the Workouts tab and pick the next session. If you don't have one yet, you can build a session from scratch or import a plan. What are you working with?
